name: Agent city
definition: The city of the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent contact family name
definition: The agent's employee contact family name.

name: Agent country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent email
definition: The email address for the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent identification number
definition: The recognized identification number used by the ship’s agent at the port of notification.

name: Agent landline number
definition: The landline telephone number for the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent name
definition: The name of the agent at the port of arrival.

name: Agent postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the referenced agent at port.

name: Agent street and number
definition: The street and number of the referenced agent at port.

name: Arrival/departure code
definition: A code in the message to show whether the information is submitted for the ship arrival or departure.

name: Authentication date time
definition: The date and time of authentication.

name: Authenticator location
definition: The location of the person when submitting the security-related information.

name: Authenticator family name
definition: The family name of the person attesting to the validity of the transmitted information.

name: Authenticator party identification number
definition: An identifying number, such as an agent identifier, of the party attesting to the validity of the transmitted information.

name: Cargo brief description
definition: A description of the type of cargo carried on the ship in general terms.

name: Transport equipment identification number
definition: Marks (letters and/or numbers) which identify a transport equipment (e.g. containers, semi-trailers, swap bodies).

name: Cargo item description of goods
definition: A description of the referenced packaged cargo.

name: Cargo item gross volume
definition: A measure of the gross volume, normally calculated by multiplying the maximum length, width and height of the cargo item.

name: Cargo item gross weight
definition: The combined weight or mass of the referenced packaged cargo and its packaging from the shipping data.

name: Cargo item HS code
definition: The standardized, international commodity code from the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System (HS) for the packaged cargo being reported.

name: Cargo item marks and numbers
definition: An alphanumeric or symbolic identifier assigned by the shipper as a means to track cargo not carried in bulk.

name: Cargo item number of packages
definition: A count of the type of package reported for the referenced cargo.

name: Cargo item package type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of package used for the referenced cargo.

name: IMO Company number
definition: The unique company identification number shown in the Continuous Synopsis Record (CSR).

name: Ship company name
definition: The name of the Company.

name: Company security officer email
definition: The contact email address for the company security officer shown in the ship security plan.

name: Company security officer landline number
definition: The contact landline number for the company security officer shown in the ship security plan.

name: Company security officer mobile number
definition: The contact mobile number for the company security officer shown in the ship security plan.

name: Company security officer family name
definition: The family name of the company security officer shown in the ship security plan.

name: Crew effects description, coded
definition: A code representing the type of the referenced crew’s effects.

name: Crew effects onboard quantity
definition: The quantity or count of the type of the referenced crew’s effects.

name: Crew effects description
definition: A description of the type of the referenced crew’s effects.

name: Crew effects sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of the referenced crew’s effects in a list.

name: Crewmember rank or rating name
definition: The description of the referenced crewmember's rank or rating on the ship.

name: Crewmember rank or rating, coded
definition: A code representing the referenced crewmember's rank or rating on the ship.

name: Person onboard sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of the referenced person in the person onboard list.

name: Stowage position onboard
definition: The position or place where goods such as dangerous goods are stored onboard the ship.

name: Dangerous goods carried indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether the ship is carrying any dangerous goods.

name: Dangerous goods EmS number
definition: The emergency schedule identified in the IMO EmS Guide – Emergency Response Procedures for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods.

name: Dangerous goods flashpoint
definition: The flashpoint of the referenced dangerous goods according to the IMO IMDG Code expressed in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit.

name: Dangerous goods hazard class, coded
definition: The hazard class code of the referenced dangerous goods according to the specified regulation.

name: Dangerous goods marine pollutant type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of marine pollutant properties for the referenced dangerous goods from the IMO IMDG Code or IBC Code / MARPOL Convention.

name: Dangerous goods mass
definition: The mass of the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Dangerous goods number of packages
definition: The count of the number of packages of the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Dangerous goods packing group
definition: The packing group according to the UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods and IMO IMDG Code.

name: Dangerous goods proper shipping name
definition: The proper shipping name for goods under IMDG Code, or the product name for goods under IBC Code and IGC Code, or the bulk cargo shipping name for goods under IMSBC Code, or the name of oil for goods under Annex I to the MARPOL Convention.

name: Dangerous goods shipper's reference number
definition: A number assigned by the shipper to track the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Dangerous goods subsidiary risks, coded
definition: Any risk in addition to the class of the referenced dangerous goods according to the IMO IMDG Code.

name: Dangerous goods technical specifications
definition: The recognized chemical or biological name or other name currently used for the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Dangerous goods UNDG number
definition: United Nations Dangerous Goods Identifier (UNDG) assigned by the UN Sub-Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods and shown in the IMO IMDG.

name: Dangerous goods volume
definition: The volume of the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Date and time of arrival - actual
definition: The date and time the ship arrives at a specified location, ATA.

name: Date and time of arrival - estimated
definition: The date and time the ship is estimated to arrive at a specified location, ETA.

name: Date and time of departure - actual
definition: The date and time the ship departs from a specified location, ATD.

name: Date and time of departure - estimated
definition: The date and time the ship is estimated to depart from a specified location, ETD.

name: Valid certificate indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether the ship has a valid certificate of the indicated type.

name: Reason why ship has no valid ISSC or interim ISSC
definition: The explanation of why the ship is not provided with a valid ISSC or a valid interim ISSC.

name: Reason why ship has no valid ISSC or interim ISSC, coded
definition: A coded explanation of why the ship is not provided with a valid ISSC or a valid interim ISSC.

name: Certificate issuer flag State, coded
definition: The code representing the country of the flag that issued the certificate.

name: Certificate expiry date
definition: The expiration date displayed on the certificate.

name: Last port of call name
definition: The name and country of the port immediately previous to the port of arrival.

name: Last port of call, coded
definition: A code representing the port immediately previous to the port of arrival.

name: Measurement unit, coded
definition: A code representing the units of measured for a referenced quantity onboard, such as crew's effects, ship's stores, and cargo.

name: Message date time
definition: The date and time the message is sent.

name: Message sender identifier
definition: The identifier of the party transmitting the message.

name: Master family name
definition: The family name of the person in charge of the ship.

name: Next port of call, coded
definition: The port immediately subsequent to the port of departure.

name: Next port of call name
definition: The name and country of the port immediately subsequent to the port of departure.

name: Number of crew
definition: The count of persons actually employed for duties onboard during a voyage in the working or service of a ship and included in the crew list.

name: Number of passengers
definition: The count of persons onboard the ship who are passengers as defined by SOLAS.

name: Number of persons onboard
definition: The total number of persons onboard the ship including crew and passengers.

name: Person in transit indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator of whether the referenced person is in transit to a foreign country.

name: Person port of embarkation, coded
definition: The code representing the port from which the referenced person embarked the ship.

name: Person port of disembarkation name
definition: The name of the port from which referenced person plans to disembark.

name: Person port of disembarkation, coded
definition: The code representing the port from which the referenced person plans to disembark the ship.

name: Person port of embarkation name
definition: The name of the port from which referenced person embarked.

name: Person visa number
definition: The number assigned to the referenced person’s visa by the issuing nation.

name: Person country of birth, coded
definition: The code representing the referenced person’s country of birth as shown on the person’s identity document.

name: Person date of birth
definition: The referenced person’s date of birth as shown on the person’s identity document.

name: Person family name
definition: The family name of the referenced person.

name: Person gender, coded
definition: A code representing the gender of the referenced person.

name: Person given name
definition: The given name of the referenced person.

name: Person identity or travel document expiry date
definition: The expiry date shown on the referenced person’s identity document.

name: Person identity or travel document issuing nation, coded
definition: A code representing the nation issuing the referenced person’s presented identity or travel document.

name: Person identity or travel document number
definition: The number assigned to the referenced person’s identity or travel document by the issuing nation.

name: Person identity or travel document type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of the referenced person’s presented identity or travel document.

name: Person nationality, coded
definition: A code representing the nationality of the referenced person as shown on the person’s identity or travel document.

name: Person place of birth name
definition: The name of the referenced person’s place of birth as shown on the person’s identity or travel document.

name: Person type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of a person onboard the ship, such as master, crew member or passenger.

name: Port of arrival, coded
definition: A code representing the port where the ship arrives.

name: Port of arrival name
definition: The name and country of the port where the ship arrives.

name: Port of call sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of a port of call on a list.

name: Port of departure, coded
definition: The code representing the port from which the ship departs.

name: Port of departure name
definition: A name and country of the port from which the ship departs.

name: Port of discharge, coded
definition: The code representing the port of discharge for the referenced cargo.

name: Port of discharge name
definition: The name and country of the port of discharge for the referenced cargo.

name: Port of last waste delivery name
definition: The name and country of the last port where waste of any type was delivered.

name: Port of last waste delivery, coded
definition: The code representing the last port where waste of any type was delivered.

name: Port of loading, coded
definition: The code representing the port of loading for the referenced cargo.

name: Port of loading name
definition: The name and country of the port where the cargo was loaded onboard the ship.

name: Port of next waste delivery name
definition: The name and country of the next port where the ship plans to deliver waste of any type.

name: Port of next waste delivery, coded
definition: The code representing the next port where the ship plans to deliver waste of any type.

name: Port of remaining waste delivery, coded
definition: The code representing the port where the ship intends to deliver the remaining waste.

name: Port of remaining waste delivery name
definition: The name and country of the port where the ship intends to deliver the remaining waste.

name: Port period of stay
definition: The scheduled duration of stay in the port of arrival in days.

name: Previous port facility call start date
definition: The start date of a previous port facility call.

name: Previous port facility call end date
definition: The end date of a previous port facility call.

name: Previous port of call name
definition: The name and country of a previous port of call.

name: Previous port of call, coded
definition: A code representing a previous port of call.

name: Authenticator role, coded
definition: A code providing the role of the person attesting to the validity of the transmitted information.

name: Certificate issuer name
definition: The name of the body/organization that issued the certificate (in case it is a notified body, an insurance company or other).

name: Security Plan approval indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator of whether the ship is provided with an approved security plan onboard.

name: Security, other matters to report
definition: An explanation of any other security-related matters to report.

name: Ship additional security measures, coded
definition: A code representing a description of special or additional security measures applied in lieu of those in the security plan.

name: Ship additional security measures, description
definition: A description of special or additional security measures applied in lieu of those in the security plan.

name: Ship call sign
definition: The ship’s identification used primarily for radio communications.

name: Ship current security level, coded
definition: A code representing the security level of the ship in the port of arrival as defined by the ISPS Code.

name: Ship flag State, coded
definition: A code representing the nationality of the ship shown on its IMO ship’s certificate.

name: Ship gross tonnage
definition: The gross tonnage shown on the ship's International Tonnage Certificate or other document issued by the flag State or recognized organization.

name: Ship IMO number
definition: The ship identification number shown on its IMO ship’s certificate.

name: Ship satellite service number
definition: The recognized mobile satellite service call number assigned to the ship by the operator and recorded in the operator's ship directory where provided.

name: Ship name
definition: The ship’s name shown on the IMO ship’s certificates.

name: Ship net tonnage
definition: The net tonnage shown on the ship's International Tonnage Certificate or other document issued by the Flag State or Recognized Organization.

name: Location in port
definition: The name of the berth, terminal or station where the ship is located in the referenced port.

name: Certificate issue date
definition: The date the certificate was issued.

name: Ship registry port, coded
definition: A code representing the port of registry shown on the IMO ship certificate.

name: Ship registry port name
definition: The name and country for the Port of Registry shown on the IMO ship certificate.

name: Ship security level in a previous port, coded
definition: A code representing the security level of the ship in a previous port as defined by the ISPS Code.

name: Ship security measures, coded
definition: A code representing the security measures taken during ship-to-ship activity by the ship in lieu of the ship security procedures.

name: Ship security measures
definition: A description of the security measures taken during ship-to-ship activity by the ship in lieu of the ship security procedures.

name: Ship stay reference number
definition: Reference number assigned by a port authority to the stay of a ship in the port.

name: Ship stores article name
definition: The name of the referenced ship stores article.

name: Ship stores article, coded
definition: A code representing the referenced ship stores article.

name: Ship stores location onboard description
definition: A description of the location on the ship of the referenced stores article.

name: Ship stores onboard quantity
definition: The number, count or amount of an article of the referenced ship stores.

name: Ship stores sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of the referenced ship stores article in a list.

name: Ship type, coded
definition: The type of the ship.

name: Ship-to-ship activity, coded
definition: A code representing the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity description
definition: A description of the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity end date
definition: The end date of the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity location name
definition: The name and country to describe where the ship-to-ship activity has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity start date
definition: The start date of the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity location, coded
definition: A code representing the location of the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Subsequent port of call name
definition: The name and country of a scheduled subsequent port of call.

name: Subsequent port of call, coded
definition: A code representing a scheduled subsequent port of call.

name: Transport contract number
definition: A reference number to identify a document evidencing a transport contract.

name: Primary purpose of call, coded
definition: A code representing the primary reason for the ship to enter the referenced port.

name: Waste estimated amount to be generated volume
definition: The estimated volume of waste to be generated between notification and next port of call (m3).

name: Waste amount to be delivered volume
definition: The volume of waste the ship plans to deliver (m3).

name: Waste amount retained volume
definition: The volume of waste the ship plans to retain onboard (m3).

name: All waste delivery indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the ship is delivering all waste onboard the ship.

name: Waste last delivery date
definition: The last date when waste of any type was delivered.

name: Waste maximum dedicated storage capacity
definition: Maximum dedicated storage capacity onboard for this type of waste in cubic metres (m3).

name: Waste reception facility point of contact
definition: The name of the person to contact at the waste reception facility regarding ship waste delivery.

name: Waste type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of waste being delivered.

name: Port facility, coded
definition: A code representing the port facility at the port of call.

name: Port facility name
definition: The name and country of a port facility at the port of call.

name: Dangerous goods additional information
definition: A statement of any other information relevant to the characteristics or hazards of the referenced dangerous goods cargo item.

name: Dangerous goods package type, coded
definition: A code representing the package type of the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Previous port facility name
definition: The name and country of a previous port facility called at during a previous port call.

name: Previous port facility, coded
definition: A code representing a previous port facility called at during a previous port call.

name: Waste description
definition: A description of the waste being delivered.

name: Voyage number
definition: An operator-assigned reference code for the ship's voyage.

name: Message type, coded
definition: Code specifying the name of a message type.

name: Ship-to-ship activity location, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: Ship-to-ship activity location, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship-to-ship activity which has been carried out during the period of the last ten calls.

name: General declaration remarks
definition: Statement of any other information relevant to ship arrival, stay or departure.

name: Vehicle identification number (VIN)
definition: The alphanumeric identifier assigned by the manufacturer to identify a vehicle e.g. for tracking purposes.

name: Dangerous goods regulation, coded
definition: Code specifying a dangerous goods regulatory instrument, such as IMDG, IBC, etc.

name: Certificate issue location, coded
definition: The code representing the location where the certificate was issued.

name: Re-inspection required indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether re-inspection is required.

name: Visited affected area indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether the ship visited an affected area identified by the World Health Organization.

name: Port of call in affected area, coded
definition: Port of call in an affected area as identified by the World Health Organization.

name: Date of call in affected area
definition: Date of the call in an affected area as identified by the World Health Organization.

name: Person died indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether any person died onboard during the international voyage otherwise than as a result of accident.

name: Disease onboard indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether there is, or has been during the international voyage, any case of disease which you suspect to be of an infectious nature.

name: Ill persons greater than expected indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether the total number of ill passengers during the international voyage has been greater than normal/expected.

name: Ill persons now indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether there is any ill person onboard now.

name: Medical practioner consulted indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether there is any ill person onboard now.

name: Infection condition onboard indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether you are aware of any condition onboard which may lead to infection or spread of disease.

name: Sanitary measure applied indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether any sanitary measure (e.g. quarantine, isolation, disinfection or decontamination) has been applied onboard.

name: Sanitary measure description
definition: Description of the sanitary measure applied.

name: Sanitary measure, place
definition: Place of applied sanitary measure.

name: Sanitary measure, date
definition: Date of applied sanitary measure.

name: Stowaway found indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether any stowaways have been found onboard. yes/no indicator whether any sanitary measure (e.g. quarantine, isolation, disinfection or decontamination) has been applied onboard.

name: Port stowaways joined ship, coded
definition: Port where the stowaways joined the ship (if known).

name: Sick animal indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether there is a sick animal or pet onboard.

name: Person embarkation date and time - actual
definition: The actual date and time when the person embarked the ship by invitation or boarded without invitation.

name: Illness
definition: Nature of illness.

name: Symptoms onset date
definition: Date of onset of symptoms.

name: Health status reported indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator that the person health status is reported to a port medical officer/radio medical services.

name: Health status, coded
definition: A code indicating whether the person recovered, is still ill or died.

name: Case disposition, coded
definition: A code indicating the disposition of the case: person or body still onboard, was evacuated, or was buried at sea.

name: Location of evacuation name
definition: The name of the port or airport to which the person was evacuated.

name: Location of evacuation, coded
definition: The code of the port or airport to which the person was evacuated.

name: Treatment
definition: Drugs, medicines or other treatment given to patient.

name: Person health details comments
definition: Comments on the specific case in the Maritime Declaration of Health attachment.

name: Anchorage name
definition: A name used to identify an anchorage. An anchorage is defined as an area in which vessels anchor or may anchor. (IHO Concept Register).

name: Terminal name
definition: A name used to identify a terminal. A terminal covers that area on shore which provides buildings and constructions for the transfer of cargo or passengers from and to ships. (IHO Concept register).

name: Pilot Boarding Place name
definition: The name, number or description used to identify a Pilot boarding place. A Pilot boarding place is the location offshore where a pilot may board a vessel in preparation to piloting it through local waters. (IHO Concept register).

name: Berth name
definition: A name used to identify a berth. A berth is defined as a place, generally named or numbered, where a vessel may moor or anchor. (IHO Concept register).

name: Berth position
definition: A name, number or description used to identify a berth position. A berth position is a specific position within a berth where a vessel may be moored or anchored. (IHO Concept register).

name: Date and time of arrival - requested
definition: The date and time the ship is requested to arrive at a specified location, RTA.

name: Date and time of arrival - planned
definition: The date and time the ship plans to arrive at a specific location, PTA.

name: Date and time of departure - requested
definition: The date and time the ship is requested to depart from a specified location, RTD.

name: Date and time of departure - planned
definition: The date and time the ship plans to depart from a specific location, PTD.

name: Number of ill persons
definition: Number of ill persons during the voyage.

name: Ship company street and number
definition: The street and number of the referenced company.

name: Ship company postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the referenced company.

name: Ship company city
definition: The city of the referenced company.

name: Ship company country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the referenced company.

name: Ship company country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the referenced company.

name: Stowaway date and time found onboard
definition: Date and time when the referenced stowaway was found onboard.

name: Stowaway port facility of boarding, coded
definition: The code representing the port facility from which the referenced stowaway boarded the ship.

name: Stowaway port facility of boarding name
definition: The name of the port facility from which the referenced stowaway boarded the ship.

name: Stowaway berth of boarding name
definition: The name of the berth at which the referenced stowaway boarded the ship.

name: Stowaway country of boarding, coded
definition: A code representing the country at which the referenced stowaway boarded the ship.

name: Stowaway Intended final destination name
definition: The name of the final destination that the stowaway intended to go to.

name: Stowaway stated reasons for boarding the ship
definition: Reasons stated by the stowaway for boarding the ship. Note: If the stowaway declares himself to be a refugee or an asylum seeker, this information shall be treated as confidential to the extent necessary to the security of the stowaway.

name: Stowaway name by which known
definition: The name of the referenced stowaway by which he or she is known.

name: Stowaway claimed nationality
definition: A code representing the nationality claimed by the stowaway.

name: Person home address street and number
definition: The street and number of the referenced person's home address.

name: Person home address postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the referenced person's home address.

name: Person home address city
definition: The city address of the referenced person's home address.

name: Person home address country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the referenced person's home address.

name: Person home address country, coded
definition: A code representing the country of the referenced person's home address.

name: Person identity or travel document issue date
definition: The issue date shown on the referenced person's identity document.

name: Stowaway photograph
definition: Photograph of the stowaway.

name: Stowaway physical description
definition: A physical description of the stowaway.

name: Stowaway first spoken language
definition: A code representing the referenced stowaway's first spoken language.

name: Stowaway first reading language
definition: A code representing the referenced stowaway's first reading language.

name: Stowaway first written language
definition: A code representing the referenced stowaway's first written language.

name: Stowaway other spoken language
definition: A code representing another language spoken by the referenced stowaway.

name: Stowaway other read language
definition: A code representing another language read by the referenced stowaway.

name: Stowaway other written language
definition: A code representing another language written by the referenced stowaway.

name: Stowaway method of boarding
definition: Method of boarding, including other persons involved (e.g. crew, port workers, etc.) and whether the stowaway was secreted in cargo/container or hidden in the ship.

name: Stowaway possessions
definition: Inventory of the stowaway’s possessions.

name: Stowaway statement
definition: Statement made by the stowaway.

name: Stowaway Master statement
definition: Statement made by the Master (including any observations on the credibility of the information provided by the stowaway).

name: Care provided to the stowaway
definition: Care provided to the stowaway (first aid, clothing, food).

name: Stowaway interview date
definition: Date of interview of the stowaway.

name: Ship satellite service provider, coded
definition: The ships recognized mobile satellite service provider.

name: Message receiver identifier
definition: The identifier of the party receiving the message (the system). Identification of specific receiver the message is intended for. This field should include  the possibility of "any" or "all" to identify a message that have no special receiver.

name: Message validity period
definition: Validity period of the message after it is sent. After this period, the client and server should cancel any outstanding actions at this point, and if appropriate, restart the request sequence.

name: Message identifier
definition: The identifier of a message. Used for asynchronous error messages or acknowledgements related to this message.

name: Message return contact point
definition: Address to which acknowledgements shall be delivered. This can be for instance an URI, and e-mail address.  If the ship chooses to poll the server, no text is given.

name: Type of message return contact point method, coded
definition: This code represents the method by which the client wants to get the replies from the server.

name: Reference message identifier
definition: The reference to the client's message to which the message is providing a response.

name: Message status, coded
definition: This code represents the status of received message.

name: Message status description
definition: A description of the details of why a message failed to be accepted.

name: Service request status, coded
definition: This code represents the status of the service request that the server returns to the client in acknowledgement and response to the request, e.g. error in data, port call denied, port call in progress, clearance successfully completed etc. If there are errors, a more specific error response information is given in the service status explanation, text.

name: Service request status description
definition: A description of the status of the service request.

name: Service name
definition: The name of the maritime service.

name: Service, coded
definition: A code representing the maritime service.

name: Service provider name
definition: The name of the party that delivers the maritime service.

name: Planned service indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the maritime service is scheduled prior to the port call.

name: Position for the service
definition: The berth or anchor name for the delivery of the maritime service in port.

name: Other position reference
definition: Further position information such as berth position or bollard number.

name: Service provider contact family name
definition: The family name of the contact in the maritime service company.

name: Service contact landline number
definition: The landline telephone number for the maritime service company.

name: Service contact mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the maritime service company.

name: Service contact email
definition: The contact email address for the maritime service company.

name: Service URL
definition: Maritime service provider end-point to the maritime service.

name: Service booking number
definition: The service booking number given by the maritime service provider.

name: Date and time of service start - estimated
definition: The date and time a service provider estimates a specified maritime service will start, ETS.

name: Date and time of service start - requested
definition: The date and time a ship requests a service provider to start a specified maritime service, RTS.

name: Date and time of service start - planned
definition: The date and time a service provider plans to start a specified service, PTS.

name: Date and time of service start - actual
definition: The date and time a maritime service provider starts a specified service, ATS.

name: Date and time of service completion - estimated
definition: The date and time a service provider estimates a specified maritime service will be completed, ETC.

name: Date and time of service completion - requested
definition: The date and time a ship requests a service provider to complete a specified maritime service, RTC.

name: Date and time of service completion - planned
definition: The date and time a service provider plans to complete a specified maritime service, PTC.

name: Date and time of service completion - actual
definition: The date and time a service provider completes a specified maritime service, ATC.

name: Message function code
definition: Code providing the function of a message.

name: Certificate identifier
definition: The identifier of the certificate, defined by the issuing organization.

name: Certificate type, coded
definition: A code representing the certificate type.

name: Certificate type acronym, coded
definition: An acronym representing the certificate type.

name: Certificate category, coded
definition:
Certificate categories are defined dependent on
•	the status of the referred regulation
•	the authorization of the issuing organization.

name: Certificate description
definition: A description of the certificate.

name: Certificate status, coded
definition: A code representing the status of the certificate.

name: Certificate status date
definition: Date when the current status has become effective.

name: Active certificate sequence number
definition: A sequence number assigned to the active certificate if there is more than one certificate of the same type. This number is defined by the certificate issuer.

name: Certificate issuer type, coded
definition: Type of organization that has issued the certificate.

name: Certificate issuer flag State name
definition: The name of the entity within the flag State authorized to issue the certificate.

name: Certificate issuer identifier
definition: The identifier representing the body/organization that issued the certificate (in case it is a RO/RSO/Class).

name: Certificate validity type, coded
definition: A code to indicate the type of validity of the certificate.

name: Certificate special condition
definition: To indicate which provisions covered by the certificate an exemption or special condition it has been issued for, if applicable.

name: Certificate extended until date
definition: The date until which the validity of the certificate has been extended.

name: Certificate last endorsement date
definition: The date when the certificate was last endorsed.

name: Company ISM certificate ship type, coded
definition: Ship type(s) authorized under the company ISM certificate.

name: Ship reporting system, coded
definition: A code representing the mandatory reporting system name reporting to.

name: Coastal station name
definition: The coastal station receiving the ship report.

name: Ship reporting system for relay, coded
definition: Identification of another reporting system to which the ship report must be relayed.

name: Report type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of report sent to the ship reporting system.

name: Ship MMSI number
definition: The unique radio identification number (ship station identity).

name: Reporting ship position, bearing
definition: The true bearing of the ship when reporting (relative location) indicated in the 360 degrees notation from true north and shall be that of the position from the landmark.

name: Reporting ship position, distance
definition: The current distance in nautical miles of the ship when reporting from/to a clearly identified landmark (relative location).

name: Reporting ship position, landmark
definition: Reference point to which the bearing and distance is estimated(relative location).

name: Course over ground
definition: The ship current course over ground indicated in the 360 degrees notation from true north.

name: Speed over ground
definition: The ship current speed over ground in decimal knots.

name: Ship reporting system entry location, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship when entering the system.

name: Ship reporting system entry location, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship when entering the system.

name: Ship reporting system entry location, time
definition: The date and time when the ship is entering the system.

name: Ship reporting system entry location, bearing
definition: The true bearing of the ship when entering the system (relative location) indicated in the 360 degrees notation from true north and shall be that of the position from the landmark.

name: Ship reporting system entry location, distance
definition: The current distance in nautical miles of the ship from/to a clearly identified landmark when entering system (relative location).

name: Ship reporting system entry location, landmark
definition: Reference point to which the bearing and distance is estimated.

name: Ship reporting system entry port, coded
definition: A code representing the port where the ship enters the system.

name: Ship reporting system entry port name
definition: A name and country of the port where the ship enters the system.

name: Ship reporting system exit location, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship when exiting the system.

name: Ship reporting system exit location, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship when exiting the system.

name: Ship reporting system exit location, date and time
definition: The date and time when the ship is exiting the system.

name: Ship reporting system exit location, bearing
definition: The true bearing of the ship when exiting the system (relative location) indicated in the 360 degrees notation from true north and shall be that of the position from the landmark.

name: Ship reporting system exit location, distance
definition: The current distance in nautical miles of the ship from/to a clearly identified landmark when exiting the system.

name: Ship reporting system exit location, landmark
definition: Reference point to which the bearing and distance is estimated.

name: Ship reporting system exit port, coded
definition: The code representing the port where the ship exits the system.

name: Ship reporting system exit port, name
definition: A name and country of the port where the ship exits the system.

name: Pilot onboard indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the ship has a deep sea or local pilot onboard.

name: Voyage waypoint sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of the referenced voyage waypoint, in the list of turn points on route within a ship reporting system area.

name: Voyage waypoint, latitude
definition: Location for ship planned voyage waypoint within a ship reporting system area, latitude.

name: Voyage waypoint, longitude
definition: Location for ship planned voyage waypoint within a ship reporting system area, longitude.

name: Voyage waypoint, date and time
definition: Date and time for planned voyage waypoint within a ship reporting system area.

name: Voyage track, type
definition: The voyage track between waypoints within a ship reporting system area.

name: Ship next report, date and time
definition: Next reporting date and time.

name: Ship draught
definition: Maximum ship present static draught in meters and centimeters.

name: Weather remarks
definition: Brief details of weather and sea conditions prevailing.

name: Wind speed
definition: The measure of wind speed.

name: Wind direction
definition: True direction, from where wind is blowing (or will blow), measured in degrees.

name: Visibility
definition: Horizontal visibility at surface or visibility towards the sea in meters.

name: Precipitation, coded
definition: A code indicating the amount of precipitation which has fallen during the period preceding the time of observation, as indicated by tR.

name: State of the sea
definition: The condition of the sea described by the significant wave height, measured in meters.

name: Dangerous goods  contact name
definition: The name of the organization from which information on dangerous goods can be obtained.

name: Dangerous goods contact mobile number
definition: The mobile number of the organization from which information on dangerous goods can be obtained.

name: Dangerous goods contact landline number
definition: The landline telephone number of the organization from which information on dangerous goods can be obtained.

name: Dangerous goods contact address street and number
definition: The street and number of the organization from which information on dangerous goods can be obtained.

name: Dangerous goods contact email
definition: The contact email address of the organization from which information on dangerous goods can be obtained.

name: Dangerous goods contact type, coded
definition: A code specifying the type of contact for dangerous goods.

name: Ship reporting system remarks type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of remark to the ship’s report.

name: Ship reporting system remarks
definition: Any other information to the ship’s report including brief details of incident and of other ships involved either in incident, assistance or salvage.

name: Ship defects or limitations
definition: Brief details of defects, damage, deficiencies or other limitations.

name: Ship defects or limitations types, coded
definition: A code representing the type of defects or limitations.

name: Ship transfer ability indicator
definition: A “Yes/No” indicator of the ability of the ship to transfer cargo ballast/fuel.

name: Waypoint name
definition: The name of the waypoint.

name: Ship actual deadweight tonnage
definition: The difference in tonnes between the displacement of a ship in water of a specific gravity of 1.025 at the actual draught and the lightweight of the ship.

name: Ship length overall
definition: Maximum length of a vessel's hull over the extreme points between fore and aft of the ship.

name: Ship extreme breadth
definition: The maximum breadth over the extreme points between port side and starboard side of the ship.

name: Ship air draught
definition: The height from the waterline to the highest point of the ship.

name: Professional medical personnel
definition: The number of personnel with medical education (e.g. doctors, nurses).

name: Medically trained personnel
definition: The number of personnel with medical training.

name: Personnel without medical training
definition: The number of personnel without medical training but engaged in administrative, caring or other medical tasks onboard.

name: Ship building contract date
definition: Date when the building contract is placed between ship builder and ship owner.

name: Ship keel laying date
definition: Date on which keel was laid or ship was at similar stage of construction.

name: Ship delivery date
definition: Date of delivery of the ship from the ship builder to the ship owner.

name: Ship responsibility organization type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of organization within a Member State that has the responsibility of the ship.

name: Ship in class indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the ship is in class of the classification society.

name: Ship class entry date
definition: Date of entry into class of the classification society.

name: Ship classification society, coded
definition: A code representing the classification society currently having the ship in class.

name: Ship classification society name
definition: The name of the classification society currently having the ship in class.

name: Ship identifier assigned by classification society
definition: Identifier assigned to the ship by the classification society.

name: Ship class status, coded
definition: A code representing the status of class certificate (referring to the class rules) for the ship.

name: Ship class notation
definition: Class notation(s) assigned by the classification society.

name: Ship maximum deadweight
definition: The difference in tonnes between the displacement of a ship in water of a specific gravity of 1.025 at the draught and the lightweight of the ship.

name: Ship company role, coded
definition: A code providing the role of the ship company.

name: Ship company identifier
definition: The identifier to be provided by the sender of the data when the company does not have an IMO identification number.

name: Inspection type, coded
definition: The code identifying the type of inspection.

name: Inspection category, coded
definition: The code identifying the inspection category.

name: Inspection performed date
definition: Date of the inspection performed.

name: Inspection performed location, coded
definition: A code representing the place of the inspection performed.

name: Inspection performed location name
definition: The location of the place of the inspection.

name: Next inspection due date
definition: Due date of the next inspection.

name: Next inspection range start date
definition: Date at which the next inspection can be performed at the earliest.

name: Next inspection range end date
definition: Date at which the next inspection should be performed at the latest.

name: Next inspection status, coded
definition: Status of the next inspection.

name: Inspection comment type, coded
definition: A code categorising the comment on conclusion of the inspection.

name: Inspection comment related certificate type acronyms
definition: The certificate type acronyms to which the inspection comment applies.

name: Inspection comment issuing date
definition: Date the inspection comment has been issued.

name: Inspection comment issuing location, coded
definition: A code representing the location where the inspection was undertaken which resulted in the imposition of the comment.

name: Inspection comment issuing location name
definition: The location where the inspection comment was issued.

name: Inspection comment due date
definition: Due date for the resolution of the comment.

name: Inspection comment expiry inspection type, coded
definition: A code indicating the expiry inspection type. i.e : the inspection when it will be verified that the comment can be closed.

name: Inspection comment status, coded
definition: A code representing the status with respect to the resolution of the comment.

name: Inspection comment postponed due date
definition: Due date for the resolution of the comment following the last postponement.

name: Inspection comment postponed expiry inspection type, coded
definition: A code indicating the postponed expiry inspection type. i.e : the inspection when it will be verified that the comment can be closed.

name: Inspection comment reference
definition: Reference to the code of the regulation/rule and the specific applicable chapters/paragraphs.

name: Inspection comment content
definition: Actual content of the comment including text, drawings, pictures, etc…

name: Inspection comment issuer, coded
definition: A code indicating the issuer of the inspection comment.

name: Inspection comment sequence number
definition: A sequence number indicating the order of the comments in an inspection.

name: Inspection comment quantity
definition: The number of comments found during the inspection.

name: PSC MoU or regime, coded
definition: A code identifying the relevant Port State Control Memorandum of Understanding or regime.

name: Deficiency, coded
definition: The code representing the deficiency found during the inspection.

name: Actions required by inspection, coded
definition: A code indicating the actions required by the inspection authority to resolve the deficiency.

name: Inspection comment resolved date
definition: The date the inspection comment  was closed.

name: Detention indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the ship was detained as a result of the inspection.

name: Detention release date
definition: The date the ship was released from detention.

name: Agreed actions
definition: Agreed actions as per rectification action plan.

name: Ship banned indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the ship has been banned from a specific area.

name: Ship ban issuer name
definition: The port State/MOU that has issued the ban to the ship.

name: Ship ban start date
definition: The date the ship ban started.

name: Ship ban end date
definition: The date the ship ban ends.

name: Ship ban area
definition: The area where the ship is banned to sail.

name: Dangerous goods marine pollutant volume
definition: The volume of the referenced marine pollutant properties for the referenced dangerous goods.

name: Cargo loss volume - estimated
definition: The estimated volume of the referenced cargo that is lost.

name: Cargo loss weight - estimated
definition: The estimated weight of the referenced cargo lost per dangerous goods or marine pollutants name.

name: Cargo loss quantity - estimated
definition: The estimated quantity (number of packages) of the referenced dangerous goods lost per dangerous goods or marine pollutant name.

name: Cargo loss condition - estimated
definition: The estimated likely condition of the lost cargo.

name: Cargo floating indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether lost cargo is floating.

name: Cargo loss continuing indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether loss is continuing.

name: Cargo loss cause description
definition: A description of the cause of the cargo loss.

name: Cargo loss position, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location where cargo was lost overboard.

name: Cargo loss position, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location where cargo was lost overboard.

name: Cargo loss date time
definition: Date and time cargo was lost.

name: Cargo loss marine pollutant type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of marine pollutant.

name: Cargo loss technical name
definition: Correct technical name of the cargo loss.

name: Cargo loss UNDG number
definition: UNDG number of the cargo loss.

name: Cargo loss movement - estimated
definition: The estimate of the movement of the cargo loss, giving current conditions if known.

name: Cargo loss surface area - estimated
definition: The estimate of the surface area of the spill if possible.

name: Cargo loss remarks
definition: Statement of any other information relevant to the cargo loss.

name: Inspection comment expiry inspection category, coded
definition: A code indicating the expiry inspection category.

name: Inspection comment postponed expiry inspection category, coded
definition: A code indicating the postponed expiry inspection category.

name: Total ballast water on board
definition: Total physical measurement of ballast water on board including sediments in cubic metres (m3).

name: Total ballast water capacity
definition: Maximum ballast water capacity onboard including sediments in cubic metres (m3).

name: Total number of ballast tanks on board
definition: Total number of ballast tanks on board certified to carry ballast water.

name: Number of tanks in ballast
definition: The number of tanks with ballast water as the ship arrives into the Arrival Port.

name: Approved ballast water management plan on board indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator of whether the ship is carrying an approved ballast water management plan on board.

name: Implementation of ballast water management plan indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether the ship management plan is implemented.

name: Ballast water record book on board indicator
definition: A ‘’yes/no" indicator of whether the ship is carrying out the ballast water record book on board.

name: Ballast water management system used
definition: Description of the ballast water management system used. If any, provide manufacturer and model.

name: Reason(s) why no ballast water management was conducted, coded
definition: The explanation of why any ballast tanks or holds to be discharged are not managed in accordance with B-3.

name: The starting date required to meet regulation D-2
definition: The date from which the ship is required to comply with regulation D-2 of the Ballast Water Management Convention, 2004.

name: Total number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged
definition: The total number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged.

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, D-1
definition: The number of tanks and holds to be discharged that were managed in accordance with regulation D-1 (BW exchange standard).

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, D-2
definition: The number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged that were managed in accordance with regulation D-2 (BW performance standard).

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, not managed
definition: The number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged that have not been managed.

name: Ballast tank or hold type, coded
definition: Type of ballast tank containing ballast water.

name: Ballast tank capacity
definition: A measure of the maximum tank/hold capacity in cubic meters.

name: Date of ballast water uptake
definition: Date of ballast water uptake into tanks/holds before ballast water management practices.

name: Location of ballast water uptake, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of  ballast water uptake in to tanks/holds before ballast water management practices.

name: Location ballast water uptake, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of  ballast water uptake in to tanks/holds before ballast water management practices.

name: Ballast water uptake port, coded
definition: The location of the port of the ballast water uptake.

name: Ballast water uptake port name
definition: The name and country of the port of the ballast water uptake.

name: Current volume in ballast tank
definition: Current volume in the ballast tanks/holds after the last uptake of ballast water in cubic metres (m3).

name: Method(s) of ballast water management, coded
definition: The method of ballast water management.

name: Other management method
definition: Any other ballast water management method used.

name: Date implementing ballast water management
definition: Date implementing ballast water management.

name: Location where ballast water exchange or flushing started, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location where ballast water exchange or flushing began.

name: Location where ballast water exchange or flushing started, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location where ballast water exchange or flushing began.

name: Location where ballast water exchange or flushing ended, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location where ballast water exchange or flushing ended.

name: Location where ballast water exchange or flushing ended, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location where ballast water exchange or flushing ended.

name: Volume ballast water exchanged
definition: The volume of ballast water exchanged in cubic metres.

name: Exchange percentage of ballast water exchanged
definition: The percentage of ballast water exchanged, calculated by dividing the total volume of water moved by "Sequential" or "Flow-through" or used in "Saltwater flushing" by the capacity of ballast tank or hold, then multiply by 100.

name: Minimum depth of water where ballast water exchange took place
definition: The minimum depth of water where the ballast water exchange took place, in metres.

name: Ballast water managed salinity
definition: A measure of the salinity of water used for ballast water management practices in Practical Salinity Units (PSU).

name: Date of ballast water discharge
definition: Date of the proposed ballast water discharge.

name: Location ballast water discharge, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of discharging ballast water.

name: Location ballast water discharge, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the proposed location of discharging ballast water.

name: Port of discharge of ballast water, coded
definition: The proposed port of discharge of ballast water.

name: Port of discharge of ballast water name
definition: The name and country of the proposed port of discharge of ballast water

name: Ballast water discharge volume
definition: The volume of the proposed ballast water discharge.

name: Ballast water discharged salinity
definition: A measure of the salinity of the proposed ballast water discharge in Practical Salinity Units (PSU).

name: Port reception facility provider
definition: The name of the port reception facility provider.

name: Treatment facility provider
definition: The name of the treatment facility provider, if different from the port reception facility provider.

name: Waste delivery date and time, from
definition: Date and time when the waste delivery started.

name: Waste delivery date and time, to
definition: Date and time when the waste delivery was completed.

name: Amount of waste received volume
definition: The volume of waste received (m3).

name: Equipment type and size, coded
definition: Code specifying the characteristics, i.e. size and type of transport equipment.

name: Gross mass verification number
definition: The identification number of verification for the verified gross mass.

name: Gross mass verified date
definition: Date and time of determining the verified gross mass of container.

name: Gross mass verifying country, coded
definition: The code of the country where the verified gross mass is determined.

name: Gross mass verifying party identifier
definition: The identifier of the gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party name
definition: The name of the responsible shipper or third party verifying the gross mass.

name: Gross mass verifying person family name
definition: The family name of person in charge of verifying the gross mass authorized by the shipper.

name: VGM measuring method, coded
definition: A code representing the Gross Mass Verifying Method.

name: Verified Gross Mass
definition: The Verified Gross Mass of the container (VGM).

name: VGM document  issue date and time
definition: The date and time of issuing the document for verified gross mass.

name: Booking reference number
definition: Booking reference assigned by carrier.

name: Seal identification number
definition: The identification number of the seal affixed to the transport equipment.

name: Authenticator, country coded
definition: A code representing the country address of the referenced authenticator.

name: Authenticator Street and number
definition: The street and number of the referenced authenticator.

name: Authenticator city
definition: The city of the referenced authenticator.

name: Authenticator postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the referenced  authenticator.

name: Authenticator email
definition: The email address for the referenced agent at port.

name: Authenticator landline number
definition: The landline telephone number for the referenced agent at port.

name: Authenticator mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the referenced agent at port.

name: Date and time of arrival at next port of call - estimated
definition: The date and time the ship is estimated to arrive at the next port of call.

name: Person onboard indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the reported person is onboard at the time of reporting.

name: Person visa issue date
definition: The date when the referenced person’s visa was issued.

name: Person visa issue location, name
definition: The name of the location where the referenced person's visa was issued.

name: Person port of disembarkation date and time - planned
definition: Date and time when the referenced person plans to disembark the ship.

name: Person landline number
definition: The landline telephone number for the referenced person.

name: Person mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the referenced person.

name: Person email
definition: The email address for the referenced person.

name: Cabin number
definition: The number of the cabin or room onboard.

name: Unique travelling booking number
definition: Unique number to identify a specific booking related to one or more passengers.

name: Unique passenger reference number
definition: Passenger's Unique Reference Number (UNR) in relation to the travel booking.

name: Gross mass verifying party email
definition: The email address for the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party landline number
definition: The landline telephone number for the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party street and number
definition: The street and number of the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party city
definition: The city of the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Gross mass verifying party postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the referenced verifying party.

name: Trade service identifier
definition: The carrier internal trade service identifier of the service.

name: Distance to destination
definition: The remaining distance in nautical miles reported by the vessel to a specific destination.

name: Average speed
definition: The average speed of the ship at the time of reporting.

name: Date and time to location in port - actual
definition: The actual date and time the ship actually reached the specified location in port.

name: Date and time to location in port - estimated
definition: The date and time the ship estimates to reach the specified location in port.

name: Date and time to location in port - requested
definition: The date and time the ship is requested to reach the specified location in port.

name: Date and time to location in port - planned
definition: The date and time the ship plans to reach the specified location in port.

name: Location in port, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of an entity.

name: Location in port, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of an entity.

name: Anchorage, coded
definition: A code used to identify an anchorage. An anchorage is defined as an area in which vessels anchor or may anchor. (IHO Concept register).

name: Terminal, coded
definition: A code used to identify a terminal. A terminal covers that area on shore which provides buildings and constructions for the transfer of cargo or passengers from and to ships. (IHO Concept register).

name: Berth, coded
definition: A code used to identify a berth. A berth is defined as a place, generally named or numbered, where a vessel may moor or anchor. (IHO Concept register).

name: Other control action taken
definition: Other control action If ballast water management were not conducted.

name: Other ship identifier
definition: Additional numbers or letters that may be used to identify the ship, as an alternative or in addition to the Ship call sign, the MMSI number or the IMO number.

name: Ship date of construction, Ballast Water Management Convention
definition: The date of construction as defined in regulation A-1.4 of the Ballast Water Management Convention.

name: Total number of ballast holds on board
definition: Total number of cargo holds on board that are designed to carry ballast water.

name: Number of holds in ballast
definition: The number of holds with ballast water as ship arrives into the Arrival Port.

name: Principal ballast water management method(s) of the ship, coded
definition: A code representing the principal ballast water management method(s) employed on this ship as stated on the Ballast Water Management certificate.

name: Principal ballast water management method of the ship description
definition: A description of the principal management method(s) employed on this ship, when required.

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, both D-1 and D-2
definition: The number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged that were managed in accordance with both regulations D-1 and D-2.

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, other method
definition: The number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged that were managed using another method.

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, other method – description
definition: The description of the ballast water management method for tanks and holds to be discharged if other than according to D-1 and/or D-2.

name: Number of ballast tanks and holds to be discharged, other method –reason
definition: The reason that an other ballast water management method was used for the tanks and holds.

name: Reason(s) why no ballast water management was conducted, description
definition: The description of the reason why any ballast tanks or holds are not managed in accordance with B-3.

name: Ballast water management system manufacturer name
definition: The name of the  manufacturer of the ballast water management system.

name: Ballast water management system model name
definition: The name of the model of the ballast water management system.

name: Ballast water management system last bypass date
definition: The date of the last bypass of the ballast water management system.

name: Ballast water management system operational indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether the ship ballast water management system is fully operational.

name: Ballast water management plan contingency measure(s), coded
definition: A code indicating the contingency measure(s) included in the Ballast Water Management Plan.

name: Ballast water management plan contingency measures description
definition: A description of the contingency measure(s) included in the Ballast Water Management Plan.

name: Ballast water management plan contingency measure(s) deployed indicator
definition: A  "yes/no" indicator on whether any contingency measure(s)  in the Ballast Water Management Plan have been deployed.

name: Ballast water ship coupling interface indicator
definition: A  "yes/no" indicator on whether the ship has an interface available for coupling to a ballast water reception facility.

name: Last survey date
definition: The date of the last survey.

name: Surveying authority name
definition: Name of the authority for the last survey.

name: Ballast tank and hold identifier
definition: Name or identification number of the ballast tank or hold.

name: Agent P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the referenced agent at port.

name: Ship company P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the referenced ship company.

name: Person home address P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the referenced person's home address.

name: Authenticator P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the referenced  authenticator.

name: Gross mass verifying party P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the referenced gross mass verifying party.

name: Master given name
definition: The given name of the person in charge of the ship.

name: Agent contact given name
definition: The agent's employee contact given name.

name: Authenticator given name
definition: The given name of the person attesting to the validity of the transmitted information.

name: Company security officer given name
definition: The given name of the company security officer shown in the ship security plan.

name: Service provider contact given name
definition: The given name of the contact in the maritime service company.

name: Gross mass verifying person given name
definition: The given name of person in charge of verifying the gross mass authorized by the shipper.

name: Crewmember performing work ashore indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the referenced crewmember performs work ashore.

name: Vehicle carried onboard remarks
definition: Additional remarks on the description of the vehicle carried onboard, in addition to make, model and license plate.

name: Vehicle model
definition: The model of the vehicle.

name: Vehicle make
definition: The make or brand of the vehicle.

name: Vehicle license plate number
definition: The license plate number of the vehicle.

name: Vehicle country of registration
definition: The country of registration of the vehicle.

name: Vehicle length
definition: The length of the vehicle.

name: Vehicle height
definition: The height of the vehicle.

name: Dangerous goods contact address P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the organization from which information on dangerous goods can be obtained.

name: Person embarkation date and time - planned
definition: The date and time when the person plans to embark the ship by invitation.

name: Sanitary measures type, coded
definition: A code representing the sanitary measure applied.

name: Event type, coded
definition: A code representing the event which triggers the reporting (e.g. Noon Report, Arrival, Departure). Event may vary according to contract.

name: Operation type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of operation being undertaken for the duration of the report (e.g. sailing, in port loading, at anchor).

name: Operation description
definition: Additional description of the operation.

name: Elapsed time
definition: The duration in hours since previous event report.

name: Ship position when reporting, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of reporting.

name: Ship position when reporting, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of reporting.

name: Ship reporting date time
definition: The date and time when the reporting event occurred.

name: Voyage remarks
definition: Remarks from the ship or any other information relevant to the voyage.

name: Voyage leg identifier
definition: The identifier used to uniquely describe a leg of a voyage. The identifier can be a reference to features in another electronic dataset such as a route plan.

name: Voyage leg remarks
definition: Remarks from the ship or any other information relevant to the voyage leg.

name: Reason for ship deviation from planned voyage description
definition: A description why the ship has deviated from the planned voyage.

name: Ship position deviation, latitude
definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of deviation.

name: Ship position deviation, longitude
definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of deviation.

name: Ship deviation start date time
definition: The date and time when the ship start its deviation from planned voyage.

name: Ship deviation stop date time
definition: The date and time when the ship stop its deviation.

name: Distance through water
definition: The distance traveled within the time elapsed, through water measured in nautical miles (includes distance sailed in bad weather or through ice if any).

name: Distance over ground
definition: The distance traveled within the time elapsed, over ground measured in nautical miles.

name: Distance sailed in ice
definition: The distance sailed within the time elapsed when navigating through ice  measured in nautical miles.

name: Distance to next port
definition: The remaining sailing distance until next port (over ground), measured in nautical miles.

name: Speed through water
definition: The average speed through water, measuredin knots.

name: Speed propeller
definition: The average of each propeller(s) speed measured in Revolutions Per Minute (RPM).

name: Speed projected
definition: The intended speed for the next 24 hours measured in knots.

name: Speed order
definition: The speed specified by the charter party measured in knots.

name: Ship true heading
definition: The direction in which the ship is pointing with respect to true north, expressed in degrees.

name: Draught forward
definition: The vertical distance in metres between the waterline and the bottom of the hull, with the thickness of the hull included from forward.

name: Draught aft
definition: The vertical distance in metres between the waterline and the bottom of the hull, with the thickness of the hull included from aft.

name: Bad weather hours
definition: The  duration in hours during which the weather conditions are unfavorable or challenging in sea state above Beaufort scale 4 (manual observation).

name: Bad weather distance
definition: The number of nautical miles experienced when sea state above Beaufort scale 4 (manual observation).

name: Wind force
definition: Force of wind on Beaufort Scale as measured by onboard ship weather station, over the time of reporting (scale from 0-12).

name: Wind direction, estimated, relative
definition: Best estimate of the direction of wind relative to the ship, measured in degrees, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Wind direction, estimated, true
definition: Best estimate of the direction of wind, measured in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Air temperature
definition: The measure of air temperature in degrees Celsius at ship location.

name: Atmospheric pressure
definition: The measure of the barometric pressure of the ship environment in atmosphere or bars.

name: Atmospheric pressure
definition: The measure of the barometric pressure of the ship environment in atmosphere or bars.

name: Sea direction, relative
definition: Best estimate of the direction of sea relative to the ship, in degrees, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Sea direction, true
definition: Best estimate of the direction of sea, in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Sea height
definition: Recorded sea height in metres as per weather provider.

name: Swell direction, relative
definition: Best estimate of the direction of swell relative to the ship, in degrees, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Swell direction, true
definition: Best estimate of the direction of swell, in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Swell height
definition: Recorded swell height in metres as per weather provider.

name: Ocean current direction, relative
definition: Best estimate of the direction of ocean current relative to the ship, in degrees, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Ocean current direction, true
definition: Best estimate of the direction of ocean current, in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

name: Ocean current direction, weather provider
definition: Direction of ocean current, in degrees, as per weather provider, if different.

name: Fresh water bunkered
definition: Fresh water bunkered onboard, measured in metric tons.

name: Fresh water produced
definition: Fresh water produced onboard by running the Fresh Water Generator, measured in metric tons.

name: Fresh water consumed
definition: Fresh drinking water consumed onboard, measured in metric tons.

name: Technical water produced
definition: Technical water (< 15 ppm) produced onboard, measured in metric tons.

name: Technical water consumed
definition: Technical water (< 15 ppm) consumed onboard, measured in metric tons.

name: Wash water consumed
definition: Wash water (for exhaust gas cleaning systems) consumed onboard, measured in metric tons.
