name: Fresh water remaining onboard
definition: Fresh drinking water remaining onboard, measured in metric tons.

name: Boiler electricity consumption
definition: Boiler electricity consumption, measured in kilowatt hours since last reporting.

name: Generator production
definition: The measure of the production of a generator not used for propulsion, in kilowatt hours since last reporting.

name: Offset electricity consumption
definition: The permitted quantity of electricity consumption during report duration which can be used to offset/correct emissions calculations, measured in kilowatt hours.

name: Power consumption for plant
definition: Power consumption from generator used for re-liquification, related to the plant (cooling of cargo), measured in kilowatt hours since last reporting.

name: Total numbers of containers, TEU
definition: The total number of containers onboard (full and empty), measured in TEU (Twenty-Foot Equivalent Unit).

name: Total number of full containers, TEU
definition: The total number of full containers onboard, measured in TEU (Twenty-Foot Equivalent Unit).

name: Total number of full reefer containers in use, TEU
definition: The total number of full reefer containers onboard in use, measured in TEU (Twenty-Foot Equivalent Unit).

name: Total number of vehicles onboard, CEU
definition: The total number of vehicles onboard, measured in CEU (Car Equivalent Unit).

name: Fuel type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of bunkered fuel.

name: Bunker delivery note number
definition: The identification number of the Bunker Delivery Note (BDN), associated to the fuel provided.

name: Bunker delivery date time
definition: The date and time as given in the BDN, e.g., the time when all fuel has been received.

name: Fuel bunker received
definition: The amount of fuel received during bunkering, measured in metric tons.

name: Fuel, mass
definition: Mass of fuel, measured in metric tonnes.

name: Fuel, density
definition: Density of fuel at 15 degrees Celsius, measured in metric tons per cubic meter.

name: Fuel, sulphur content
definition: Sulphur content in fuel, measured in percentage per millimeter (% m/m).

name: Fuel, viscosity
definition: Viscosity of fuel, measured in centistoke (cSt).

name: Fuel, water content
definition: Water content of fuel, measured in percentage in % Volume/Volume.

name: Fuel, higher heating value
definition: Higher heating value of the fuel (calorific value), measured in megajoules per kilogram.

name: Fuel, lower heating value
definition: Lower heating value of the fuel (calorific value), measured in megajoules per kilogram.

name: Fuel grade, coded
definition: Information referring to the fuel grade, quality and composition.

name: Fuel bunker port, coded
definition: A code representing the port where the fuel is to be bunkered, according to a bunker delivery note.

name: Fuel bunker port, name
definition: The name and country of the port where the fuel is to be bunkered, according to a bunker delivery note.

name: Fuel Carbon Dioxide emission
definition: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) emission, expressed in emissions per metric per gram (gCO2/g).

name: Total fuel quantity consumed
definition: Total fuel consumed, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Fuel consumed, by Main Engine
definition: Fuel consumed by Main Engine, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Fuel consumed by Diesel Electric Propulsion
definition: Fuel consumed by diesel electric propulsion, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Fuel consumed, by Diesel Generator
definition: Fuel consumed by Diesel Generator, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Fuel consumed, by Auxiliary Boiler
definition: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Boiler, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Fuel quantity remaining onboard
definition: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Sludge remaining onboard
definition: Amount of sludge remaining onboard, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

name: Cylinder lube oil remaining onboard
definition: The cylinder lube oil remaining onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons.

name: Cylinder lube oil, Feed Rate
definition: The rate of feed of lube oil into the cylinder, measured in grams per kilowatt hour (g/kWh).

name: Cylinder lube oil, consumption
definition: Lube oil consumption in grams per hour per unit of output measured in kilowatt of the engine (g/kWh).

name: Cylinder lube oil, received
definition: Lube oil received during bunkering, measured in metric tons.

name: Fuel type trade name, coded
definition: A code representing the trade name of the fuel.

name: Shipper (Consignor) identifier
definition: The identifier of person or legal entity by whom or on whose behalf, a contract of carriage of goods by sea has been concluded with a carrier, or any person by whom or in whose name, or on whose behalf, the goods are actually delivered to the carrier in relation to the contract of carriage by sea.

name: Shipper (Consignor) name
definition: The name of person or legal entity by whom or on whose behalf, a contract of carriage of goods by sea has been concluded with a carrier, or any person by whom or in whose name, or on whose behalf, the goods are actually delivered to the carrier in relation to the contract of carriage.

name: Shipper (Consignor) contact family name
definition: The shipper's (consignor's) employee contact family name.

name: Shipper (Consignor) contact given name
definition: The shipper's (consignor's) employee contact given name.

name: Shipper (Consignor) email
definition: The email address of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) landline number
definition: The landline telephone number of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) mobile number
definition: The mobile number of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) street and number
definition: The street and number of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) city
definition: The city of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the shipper (consignor).

name: Shipper (Consignor) P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the shipper (consignor).

name: Consignee identifier
definition: The identifier of person or legal entity to whom a cargo is consigned under a contract of carriage or a transport document or electronic transport record.

name: Consignee name
definition: The name of person or legal entity to whom a cargo is consigned under a contract of carriage or a transport document or electronic transport record.

name: Consignee contact family name
definition: The consignee's employee contact family name.

name: Consignor contact given name
definition: The consignee's employee contact given name.

name: Consignee email
definition: The email address of the consignee.

name: Consignee landline number
definition: The landline telephone number of the consignee.

name: Consignee mobile number
definition: The mobile number of the consignee.

name: Consignee country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the consignee.

name: Consignee street and number
definition: The street and number of the consignee.

name: Consignee city
definition: The city of the consignee.

name: Consignee country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the consignee.

name: Consignee postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the consignee.

name: Consignee P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the consignee.

name: Carrier identifier
definition: The identifier of person or legal entity to whom a cargo is consigned under a contract of carriage or a transport document or electronic transport record.

name: Carrier name
definition: The name of person or legal entity to whom a cargo is consigned under a contract of carriage or a transport document or electronic transport record.

name: Carrier contact family name
definition: The carrier's employee contact family name.

name: Carrier contact given name
definition: The carrier's employee contact given name.

name: Carrier email
definition: The email address of the carrier.

name: Carrier landline number
definition: The landline telephone number of the carrier.

name: Carrier mobile number
definition: The mobile number of the carrier.

name: Carrier country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the carrier.

name: Carrier street and number
definition: The street and number of the carrier.

name: Carrier city
definition: The city of the carrier.

name: Carrier country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the carrier.

name: Carrier postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the carrier.

name: Carrier P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the carrier.

name: Voyage charter party date
definition: The date used to identify the voyage charter party under which the bill of lading is issued.

name: Notify party identifier
definition: The identifier of person or company to be advised by the carrier upon arrival of the goods at the destination port, as per charter party.

name: Notify party name
definition: The name of person or company to be advised by the carrier upon arrival of the goods at the destination port, as per charter party.

name: Notify party contact family name
definition: The notify party's employee contact family name.

name: Notify party contact given name
definition: The notify party's employee contact given name.

name: Notify party email
definition: The email address of the notify party.

name: Notify party landline number
definition: The landline telephone number of the notify party.

name: Notify party mobile number
definition: The mobile number of the notify party.

name: Notify party country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the notify party.

name: Notify party street and number
definition: The street and number of the notify party.

name: Notify party city
definition: The city of the notify party.

name: Notify party country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the notify party.

name: Notify party postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the notify party.

name: Notify party P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the notify party.

name: Bill of Lading reference identifier
definition: A reference number issued on the bill of lading.

name: Shipped on Deck description
definition: A description of cargo (and amount of cargo) shipped on deck at shipper's risk.

name: Shipped on Deck quantity
definition: The quantity of cargo shipped on deck at shipper's risk.

name: Bill of Lading issued location, coded
definition: The code representing the location where the Bill of Lading was issued.

name: Bill of Lading issued date
definition: The date when the bill of lading is issued.

name: Number of original Bill of Ladings
definition: Number of original B/L(s) that have been issued.

name: Number of Bill of Lading copies
definition: Number of copies of the B/L that have been issued.

name: Shipped on board date
definition: The date when the cargo as linked to in the bill of lading is physically on board the ship indicated on the bill of lading.

name: Terms and conditions
definition: A description of the general terms and conditions in the transport document.

name: Carrier Clauses
definition: A description of additional clauses for a specific shipment added by the carrier to the bill of lading, subject to local rules/guidelines or certain mandatory information required to be shared with the customer.

name: Delivery alongside date time
definition: The date and time when the bunker tanker arrives alongside the receiving vessel.

name: Bunker metering ticket number
definition: The mass flow metering ticket number for each bunker delivery.

name: Bunker supply method, coded
definition: A code representing the bunker supply method.

name: Bunker tanker name
definition: The name of the bunker tanker involved in the bunker delivery process.

name: Supplier representative name
definition: The name of the supplier representative  (licensed cargo officer) on duty during the fuel transfer.

name: Supplier representative signature date time
definition: Thedate and time of the supplier representative (cargo officer) ’s signature.

name: Supplier mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the supplier.

name: Supplier country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the supplier.

name: Supplier street and number
definition: The street and number of the supplier.

name: Supplier city
definition: The city of the supplier.

name: Supplier country sub-division name
definition: The country sub-division of the notify supplier.

name: Supplier postcode
definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the supplier.

name: Supplier P.O. Box
definition: The post office box of the supplier.

name: Bunker delivery note issue date
definition: The date when the Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) was issued.

name: Delivery location name
definition: The name of the exact location of delivery within the port mentioned in the Delivery field (i.e. Anchorages or berths of operations).

name: Bunker fuel flash point
definition: The flash Point of the bunker supplied as from the certificate of quality (COQ) of the bunker cargo loaded (ISO2719) (Celsius).

name: Ship representative name
definition: The name of the ship representative (Master or Chief Engineer) onboard the receiving vessel responsible for overseeing the

name: Ship representative signature date time
definition: The date and time of the ship representative (Captain or Chief Engineer)’s signature.

name: Other requestor party name
definition: Name of other requester sample collected for

name: Letter of protest issued indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether a letter of protest has been issued.

name: Letter of protest remarks
definition: Remarks related to the letter of protest.

name: Customer Rating, coded
definition: A code representing the customer feedback by the receiving vessels’ Master/Chief Engineer.

name: Commence pumping date time
definition: The date and time of start of delivery (pump start).

name: Complete pumping date time
definition: The date and time of end of delivery (pump stop).

name: Delivered quantity
definition: The total quantity delivered, in metric tons/in cubic meters, is the cumulative mass quantity measured between the start of delivery and end of delivery, and transferred to the vessel at the custody transfer point.

name: Bunker supplier remarks
definition: The remarks by bunker supplier.

name: Bunker tanker license number
definition: The local license number of delivery bunker tanker.

name: Safety Data Sheet Received indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for the fuel was provided to the receiving vessel.

name: Sulphur purchaser limit
definition: The specific sulphur limit of the bunker fuel required by purchaser.

name: Bunker supplier company identification number
definition: The unique identifier of the bunker supplier company.

name: Bunker supplier licence number
definition: The supplier's licence number issued by local authority.

name: Bunker supplier name
definition: The name of the bunker supplier which is licensed by implementing authority.

name: Bunker supply declaration description
definition: A description of the declaration that bunker fuel supplied conforms with MARPOL Annex VI. A formal declaration provided by the bunker supplier confirming that the bunker fuel supplied complies with the relevant regulations and standards, including adherence to MARPOL Annex VI requirements regarding emissions and fuel quality specifications.

name: Bunker tanker retained sample counter seal
definition: The 3rd party (e.g. surveyor) counter seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by bunker tanker.

name: Bunker tanker retained sample seal
definition: The supplier seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by bunker tanker.

name: MARPOL sample counter seal number
definition: The 3rd party (e.g. surveyor) counter seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained as MARPOL sample.

name: MARPOL sample seal number
definition: The supplier seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained as MARPOL sample.

name: Other retained sample counter seal
definition: The 3rd party (e.g. surveyor) counter seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by others.

name: Other retained sample seal
definition: The supplier seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by others.

name: Surveyor retained sample counter seal
definition: The 3rd party (e.g. surveyor) counter seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by surveyor.

name: Surveyor retained sample seal
definition: The supplier seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by surveyor.

name: Vessel retained sample counter seal
definition: The 3rd party (e.g. surveyor) counter seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by vessel.

name: Vessel retained sample seal
definition: The supplier seal numbers applied on the sample bottles, retained by vessel.

name: Fuel bunker certificate of quality (COQ) reference
definition: The identifier reference to the certificate of quality related to the actual test results on the product that will be delivered.

name: Fuel bunker temperature
definition: The temperature of the fuel bunkers in the bunker tanker / supplying barge. Measured in degree Celsius. (Numeric value with two decimals).

name: Fuel bunker pour point
definition: The lowest temperature at which the fuel stop to flow. The pour point determines the minimum temperature required for storage and handling onboard of fuel oil products. Measured in degree Celsius. (Numeric value with two decimals).

name: Fuel bunker pumping rate
definition: The maximum pumping rate of the fuel being supplied by the bunker barge. Measurement is cubic meters per hour, or metric tonne per hour. (Numeric field, integer).

name: Fuel bunker measuring type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of the system engaged by the Bunker Barge for measuring the flow in order to calculate the quantity of fuel bunkers supplied.

name: Fuel bunker supply type, coded
definition: A code representing whether the fuel is intended to be used domestically or not, by the receiving ship.

name: Fuel bunker procurement order ID
definition: The identifier reference to the fuel bunker procurement document.

name: Bunker barge cast-off date time
definition: The date and time indicating when the bunker barge is sailing away from the receiving ship once bunkering is completed.

name: Fuel bunker sampling location, coded
definition: A code representing the location of where the MARPOL sample(s) has/have been taken; either at the fuel barge/tanker or at the receiving ships manifold.

name: DPG list on board indicator
definition: A yes/no indicator whether a list or manifest or appropriate stowage plan giving details of the dangerous goods or marine pollutants (DGP) carried and of their location on the ship is on board.

name: Cargo operation, coded
definition: A code representing an indication of whether cargo will be loaded, unloaded or will remain on board (transit) at a location in the port.

name: Dangerous goods segregation group, coded
definition: A code identifying the segregation group of the dangerous good item as defined in the IMDG code.

name: Limited quantities indicator
definition: A yes/no indicator whether the dangerous goods are packed in small quantities.

name: Cargo, viscosity
definition: A measure of the viscosity of the cargo in millipascal-second (mPa.s).

name: Cargo, melting point
definition: A measure of the melting point of the cargo in degrees Celsius.

name: Cargo, discharge temperature
definition: A measure of the temperature at which the cargo is discharged in degrees Celsius.

name: Class 7 nuclide name
definition: The radio nuclide name of a class 7 product (IMDG Code).

name: Class 7 category, coded
definition: A code representing the category of Class 7 product (IMDG Code).

name: Radioactive index of transport
definition: A measure of the maximum radiation level at a distance of 1m from the external surface in units of becquerels (Bq).

name: Radioactive criticality safety index
definition: A number, assigned to fissile material i.e. material capable of sustaining a nuclear chain reaction, which is used to provide control over the accumulation of packages containing such material.

name: Class 7 maximum activity
definition: A measure of the maximum activity of class 7 product (IMDG Code) in units of becquerels (Bq).

name: Net explosive mass
definition: The mass of the explosive part or substance of goods without any packing in kilograms (kg).

name: Transport equipment full or empty indicator, coded
definition: A code indicating whether the transport equipment is full or empty.

name: Tank status, coded
definition: A code specifying if a tank container or tank contains goods or not and what the atmosphere in the tank container or tank is.

name: Fumigated bulk cargo holds indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the specified cargo hold or tank is fumigated

name: Empty tank last cargo hazard class, coded
definition: A code representing the IMO hazard class of the last dangerous goods or polluting cargo carried in the particular empty tank.

name: Empty tank last dangerous cargo name
definition: The proper shipping name of the last dangerous or polluting cargo carried in the particular empty tank.

name: Empty tank last cargo marine pollutant type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of marine pollutant properties for the last dangerous or polluting cargo carried in the particular empty tank from the IMO IMDG Code or IBC Code / MARPOL Convention.

name: Fumigant name
definition: The chemical or technical name of the fumigant used.

name: Fumigation date
definition: The date when the cargo was fumigated.

name: Fumigation location, coded
definition: The place or port where the cargo was fumigated.

name: Fumigation method description
definition: The method used for fumigation e.g. sleeves, pills.

name: Fumigation ventilated indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the cargo hold has been ventilated after treatment with a fumigating substance.

name: Fumigation gas check indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether the referenced cargo tank or hold has been checked for the presence of a fumigation gas prior to arrival.

name: Fumigation gas particle measure
definition: A measure of the value in particle volume per million for a location with fumigation gas.

name: Sealing party role, coded
definition: The code specifying the role of the sealing party.

name: Seal party name
definition: The name of the sealing party.

name: Resealing party role, coded
definition: The code specifying the role of the resealing party.

name: Reseal party name
definition: The name of the resealing party.

name: Resealing date time
definition: The date and time when the container was resealed.

name: Seal condition
definition: The code identifying the condition of the container seal at its time of inspection.

name: CIP inspection results issue date time
definition: The date and time the CIP inspection results were issued.

name: CIP inspection applicant name
definition: The name of the applicant of the CIP inspection.

name: CIP inspection applicant street and number
definition: The street and number of the applicant of the CIP inspection.

name: CIP inspection applicant postcode
definition: The postcode of the applicant of the CIP inspection.

name: CIP inspection applicant contact name
definition: Either name of the individual or their department name for the purpose of communication.

name: CIP inspection applicant contact identifier
definition: Identifier for the type of means of communication of the applicant. E.g. mail, fax, cell phone, etc.

name: CIP inspection applicant email
definition: The email address for the referenced CIP inspection applicant.

name: CIP inspection applicant landline number
definition: The landline telephone number for the referenced CIP inspection applicant.

name: CIP inspection applicant mobile number
definition: The mobile number for the referenced CIP inspection applicant.

name: Undeclared Dangerous Goods number of packages
definition: Number of packages reported as undeclared dangerous goods in the referenced transport equipment unit.

name: Misdeclared Dangerous Goods number of packages
definition: Number of packages identified as misdeclared dangerous goods in the corresponding transport equipment unit.

name: CTU Inspection deficiency type, coded
definition: Type(s) of deficiencies identified by the CTU inspector during the inspection of the CTU.

name: CTU Inspection deficiency found indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator whether deficiencies are found in the CTU inspection.

name: Detection result of dangerous goods
definition: Detection result description of dangerous goods.

name: Dangerous goods identified by UNDG indicator
definition: A "yes/no" indicator whether dangerous goods are identified by the UNDG number.

name: Dangerous goods handling remarks
definition: Additional handling information of the dangerous goods.

name: CIP inspection method, coded
definition: The code identifying whether the inspection was conducted manually or with an automatic system.

name: Agency responsible for inspection system, coded
definition: The code identifying the agency responsible for the inspection system.

name: Agency responsible for CIP inspection contact name
definition: The contact name of the agency responsible for CIP inspection.

name: Agency responsible for CIP inspection street and number
definition: The street and number of the agency responsible for CIP inspection.

name: Inspection system name
definition: The name of the system utilized to conduct inspection.

name: Document attached Information
definition: Description of attached documents submitted or handled with the corresponding inspection certificate.

name: CIP deficiency report content
definition: Actual content of the deficiency report detailing the non-compliance and required corrective actions.

name: Location of pest contamination found, coded

name: Observation internal identifier
definition: An internal identifier created by the ship operator for a station (device) prior to assignment of a SOT – ID.

name: Ship Observations Team Identifier (SOT – ID)
definition: Identifier used in submissions to Observing Systems Capability Analysis and Review tool (OSCAR) and Global Telecommunication System (GTS/WIS 2), provided by OceanOPS and supports the maintenance of metadata inventories for all marine stations).

name: Model Main Station, coded
definition: A code representing the model of the device used to take the observation.

name: Model Main Station, name
definition: Name of the model of the device used to take the observation, if not available via code.

name: Telecom type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of telecommunications used in the transmission of the observation.

name: Telecom type, name
definition: Name of the type of telecommunications used in the transmission of the observation

name: Observation start date time
definition: The date and time that observations began to be transmitted from the (station).

name: Sensor make and model, coded
definition: A code representing the make and model of the sensor used for the observation.

name: Sensor make and model, name
definition: The name of the make and model of the sensor used for the observation, if not available via code.

name: Sensor height
definition: The sensor height above sea surface in meters, to the nearest tenth meter.

name: Sensor location, coded
definition: A code representing the location of the sensor used for the observation.

name: Sensor location, name
definition: The name of the location of the sensor used for the observation, if not available via code.

name: Sea surface temperature
definition: The measure of sea temperature in degrees Celsius.

name: Relative humidity
definition: The measure of water vapor in the atmosphere relative to the temperature of the air, expressed as a percentage.

name: Sea surface salinity
definition: The measure of sea surface salinity in practical salinity units (PSU).

name: Sea ice extent
definition: An estimate of the sea ice concentration in a specified oceanic area, expressed as a percentage, derived from human observation.

name: Mail category, coded
definition: The category of the mail being documented.

name: Number of letter-post receptacles
definition: The number of receptacles containing letter-post items included in the mail dispatch.

name: Number of postal parcels receptacles and loose parcels
definition: The number of receptacles containing postal parcels (CP) and the number of loose parcels included in the mail dispatch.

name: Number of sacks of empty bags
definition: The number of receptacles consisting of sacks of empty mailbags returned in the mail dispatch.

name: Gross weight of letter posts
definition: The weight of the letter post receptacles for the mail class in this consignment,expressedin kilograms. It is the sum of receptacle weights all kept with a precision of 0.1 kg.

name: Gross weight of parcel
definition: The weight of the parcel receptacles for the mail class in this consignment, expressed in kilograms. It is the sum of receptacle weights all kept with a precision of 0.1 kg.

name: Gross weight of empty receptacle
definition: The weight of the empty receptacles for the mail class in this consignment, expressed in kilograms. It is the sum of receptacle weights all kept with a precision of 0.1 kg.

name: Observations
definition: Free-text field used to provide complementary information or remarks regarding the consignment as recorded in the CN37 observation field.

name: Cargo indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator specifying whether the ship is carrying cargo, whether laden or unladen at the time of inspection.

name: Cargo gross weight
definition: The total gross weight, in metric tonnes, of cargo carried on board the ship at the time of inspection, if applicable.

name: Result of inspection, coded
definition: The result of the SSC inspection.

name: Result of inspection description
definition: Description of the result of the SSC inspection.

name: SSC extension expiration date
definition: Date of expiry of the provided extension.

name: Port of extension name
definition: Name of the port of extension of the existing certificate.

name: Port of extension, coded
definition: A code representing the port of extension of the existing certificate.

name: SSC extension provided date
definition: Date that an extension of the existing certificate was provided.

name: Inspecting officer given name
definition: The given name of the ship’s inspecting officer.

name: Inspecting officer family name
definition: The Last Name of the ship’s inspecting officer.

name: Inspecting office country code
definition: A code representing the country address of the inspecting officer.

definition: An alphanumerical code representing the postal area of the inspecting officer.

name: Inspecting office street and number
definition: The street and number of the inspecting officer.

name: Inspected area name
definition: Name of the inspected area.

name: Inspected area, coded
definition: A code representing the inspected area.

name: Public health evidence found, coded
definition: A code representing whether public health evidence was found in the inspected area.

name: Public health evidence found comments
definition: Comments on public health evidence found in the inspected area.

name: Sample type, coded
definition: A code representing the type of samples taken on board.

name: Sample type, text
definition: A text describing the sample type.

name: Sample results, coded
definition: A code representing results from samples taken on board.

name: Control measures applied indicator
definition: An indicator representing whether control measures have been applied for the finding.

name: Control measures applied comments
definition: Notes or observations regarding the control measures that have been implemented.

name: Re-inspection date remarks
definition: Remarks regarding the date of the next re-inspection.

name: Comments regarding conditions found
definition: A narrative description of observations and remarks regarding conditions identified during the ship sanitation inspection.

name: Documents reviewed, coded
definition: A code representing a document type reviewed by the inspector for the overall inspection.

name: Documents reviewed description
definition: Description of the reviewed document type.

name: Detected health events on board indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator specifying whether health events have been detected on board the conveyance at the time of inspection.

name: Evidence found, coded
definition: A code representing the WHO checklist evidence item found during the inspection.

name: Evidence found description
definition: A text describing the evidence item found during the inspection, aligned with the WHO checklist entry referenced by Evidence (WHO), coded.

name: Control measures to be applied
definition: The control measures and corrective actions for each evidence found during the inspection, according to the checklist of the WHO “Handbook for Inspection of Ships and Issuance of Ship Sanitation Certificates”.

name: Required control measures indicator
definition: An indicator specifying whether the control measure associated with the evidence found is mandatory according to the WHO inspection checklist.

name: Department onboard, coded
definition: A code representing the onboard department to which the seafarer is assigned for the execution of their professional responsibilities.

name: Additional person details
definition: A text specifying supplementary information about the referenced person.

name: STCW medical compliance indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator specifying whether the seafarer meet the standards in STCW Code Section A-1/9.

name: STCW medical compliance limitations description
definition: Description of restrictions to STCW Code medical standards (if any).

name: Fit for navigational duties indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator specifying whether the seafarer holds a valid medical certification to perform navigational duties.

name: Navigational duties limitations description
definition: Description of restrictions on performing navigational duties (if any).

name: Fit for safety function indicator
definition: A “yes/no” indicator specifying whether the seafarer holds a valid medical certification confirming fitness to perform assigned safety-related duties.

name: Name of the office of exchange of origin

name: Name of the office of exchange of destination
